title: It's All About the Confidence: An Unsupervised Approach for Multilingual Historical Entity Linking using Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing Entity Linking and NIL prediction performance metrics (F1, Precision, Recall) across six European languages to evaluate disparities, specifically demonstrating reduced accuracy for structurally complex and under-represented Nordic languages (Finnish and Swedish).

Analyzing NIL (non-existent entity) prediction recall and false negative rates to identify the models' intrinsic bias toward selecting existing Knowledge Base candidates rather than correctly outputting a NIL prediction.
